value.body: When a patient uses health insurance, the hospital's insurance (TPA) desk asks the insurer or its third-party administrator (TPA) for cashless approval, sends the bills at discharge and follows up on the claim. The same role exists on the other side, at TPAs and insurers, checking those claims. The day is mostly document checks, portal entries and calls with patients and insurers.

items.label: Typical entry
items.note: Claim-processing teams at TPAs also hire nursing and life-science graduates

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Insurer and TPA portals, hospital billing software, Excel

items.label: Key terms
items.value: Pre-authorisation, cashless, reimbursement, room-rent limits, deductions

items.label: Claims settled through TPAs
items.note: The rest are settled in-house by insurers

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers join a hospital's insurance or billing desk, or a TPA or insurer's claims team, usually as a trainee. Hospitals often train new staff on each insurer's process on the job.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Explaining approvals and deductions to patients

value.title: At a glance
items: Common next roles: insurance desk lead, billing manager, claims team lead.
Health-insurance coverage has grown, which keeps this desk busy in most private hospitals.
Disputes over deductions are frequent, so patience and accuracy matter.
